⚡ Everything In One Place

Built for Modern Servers

Replace 5 different bots with one lightweight, reliable solution.

🛡️

Anti-Nuke Defense Shield

Real-time sliding-window surveillance prevents rogue staff and raid bots from deleting channels, deleting roles, or mass-banning members. Automatically quarantines or bans perpetrators.

/antinuke enable /antinuke settings /antinuke whitelist
⚖️

Disciplinary Jail System

Confines disruptive members to an isolated #jail channel, automatically strips administrative roles, logs time served, and restores their original roles automatically upon release.

/jail setup /jail user /jail unjail
📜

Automated Audit Logging

One-click setup automatically creates an admin-only category with 5 dedicated logging channels for Moderation, Server changes, Voice activity, Economy, and Join/Leave events.

/logs setup /logs view
🔊

Join-to-Create Temp VC

Members join a designated hub to create their own temporary voice channel with full owner controls: lock, unlock, hide, user limit, and kick unwanted members.

/tempvc setup /tempvc panel
🔘

Interactive Button Roles

Build beautiful embed panels with up to 5 self-assignable buttons. Instant toggle feedback with zero typing required.

/buttonrole quick /buttonrole add

❓ Got Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I set up 𝐌𝐨𝐫𝐩𝐡𝐲𝐳 in my server? +
Setting up 𝐌𝐨𝐫𝐩𝐡𝐲𝐳 is 100% handled directly through your Discord server! Once invited, you can configure modules using automated commands like /logs setup (auto-creates an admin-only log category) or /jail setup (auto-creates the isolated #jail channel). All commands and how they work can be easily understood either right here on this website or by typing /help in any server channel.
Is Morphyz completely free to use? +
Yes, Morphyz is 100% free with zero paywalls. All core features—Anti-Nuke, disciplinary jail, audit logging, and temporary voice channels—are available to every community at no cost.
How does the Anti-Nuke defense system work? +
Morphyz monitors audit logs using a sliding-window tracker (e.g. 10 seconds). If a user exceeds safe thresholds (such as deleting 3 channels or banning 3 members), Morphyz immediately strips their administrative roles (quarantine) or bans them, while pinging server staff in your alert channel.
How do Join-to-Create temporary voice channels work? +
When a member joins the designated hub channel, Morphyz automatically creates a private temporary voice channel for them with an interactive control panel. The channel owner can lock, hide, or set member limits, and the channel is automatically deleted when empty.
How does the Disciplinary Jail restore roles? +
When you run /jail user, Morphyz records all of the member's current roles into its persistent database before stripping them and assigning @Jailed. When the user is unjailed (manually or via sentence timer), all original roles are automatically re-applied!
